## define.ts

### `interface ComponentDoc`

The documentation manifest of one component folder. See AGENTS.md, Law 2.

- `name` :: The primary export, PascalCase — `Button`.
- `summary` :: One sentence. Shown in the index and the page header.
- `description` :: One to three paragraphs. A blank line starts a new paragraph; `code` is allowed.
- `parts` :: Every non-primary component export → one line on what it is for.
- `features` :: Short capability bullets.
- `accessibility` :: How the component is accessible — at least one statement.
- `keyboard` :: Keyboard interactions, when the component is interactive.
- `api` :: Non-component exports: functions, attachments, classes, stores.
- `related` :: Slugs of related components.
